rationale: Tidy the parent's next-question list now that the trim consumer it named has been settled by the child account: the answer is that the drifted values do change the trim bound and trim acts on it (witnessed: compacted index 7 over six indices of content, receipt ec3329dc273e452aa92bcd44652c116a), with the snapshot path reaching the same class of consequence through the drifted decided index. The parent's discriminator therefore keeps only the questions an execution can still settle - whether anything inside the sealed configuration bounds or repairs the drift after many more rounds or a later leader change - while the handoff item stays as the sourced narrowing recorded earlier and the trim/snapshot consumers are now recorded in their own child accounts.

investigations.discriminator: Whether anything inside the sealed configuration bounds or repairs the drift - a counter or storage limit, or a later leader change - after many more re-synchronization rounds; the decisive observation would be the reported accepted and decided indices and the readable decided log after further rounds and further leader changes. The library's own reconfiguration handoff is already narrowed out (the StopSign carries only the next configuration and metadata while the documented flow builds the new instance with fresh storage), and the drifted values' effect on the compaction paths is settled in the trim and snapshot child accounts.
